fusions.name: Strand Barrage
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands of arcana in a spread, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Snaring Lock
fusions.desc: Lashes a lock of conjured strands at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times at full range, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Curtain
fusions.desc: Weaves a wall of arcane strands 6 tiles long ahead of you that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spellbound Braid
fusions.desc: Conjures a braided charm: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, each kill returns 2 health, and your maximum health rises by 10.
